items.title: U.S. stock futures dip as investors await inflation data, grapple with more Iran uncertainty
items.description: U.S. stock-index futures were little changed on Sunday, after new demands from Iran raised fresh doubts about the Strait of Hormuz reopening anytime soon and as investors await key inflation data late

items.title: ‘I’m easing into retirement’: I’m getting an $80,000 pension payout. Where can I invest it safely?
items.description: “I expect to have several years before I take distributions from my 401(k) account.”

items.title: If I marry my girlfriend, 67, will she lose her Supplemental Security Income and divorced spouse benefits?
items.description: “She has been living with me for four years.”

items.title: The number of stocks beating the S&P 500 is the highest in 4 years. Why that number should rise.
items.description: For the first time in four years, the average stock is beating the stock market.

items.title: ‘My wife and I are both retired’: Do we dip into our $2.3 million fund to pay off our $300,000 mortgage at 2.9%?
items.description: “Right now, we’re withdrawing about $100,000 a year from our investments.”

items.title: S&P 500 sales growth is at a nearly 5-year high. Here’s what’s behind the surge.
items.description: Energy companies in the S&P 500 have put up a 42.5% revenue gain in the second quarter, powering the index’s sales performance.

items.title: ‘I don’t wish to be cold-hearted’: My elderly relative can no longer care for himself. Am I wrong to leave his care to the state?
items.description: “He has never been particularly generous or nurturing.”

items.title: ‘This has been an emotionally difficult time’: My brother has cancer and my father is 94. How do I shoulder this responsibility?
items.description: “My father placed his $600,000 Wisconsin home into a revocable trust, naming my brother as beneficiary.”

items.title: I got two email invitations from friends. Is this a phishing scam — or am I suddenly popular?
items.description: “I was surprised — and flattered — to find myself on the guest list.”

items.title: ‘Her bank accounts were stripped bare by Medicaid’: My late friend had $20,000 in credit-card debt. Will her life insurance pay for it?
items.description: “She left behind a 30-year-old son and 32-year-old daughter.”
